senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; נוּד)shaking; מְנוֹד רֹאשׁ shaking of the head, ready assent, submission.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:6">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> (ref. to the shapes of certain letters, v. <cite ref="K01043"><he>כָּפַף</he></cite>) <he>שניתנה התורה במ׳ ר׳</he> (Ar. only <he>במָ׳</he>) the Law has been given under repeated signs of assent.
